meta.title: `GET /api/event_groups` requires trade read permission
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot explicitly remove trade read permission; the vendor actor is used as the user without that permission.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (trade read permission) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.

expected.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
